scope: Targeted primary-source review of practitioner CHoCH usage, direct SMC/CHoCH research and related technical-analysis/microstructure literature. Not exhaustive; no external result independently replicated.

sources.title: Market Structure Shift (MSS) in Trading
sources.author: FXOpen
sources.supports: Author's use of displacement, context and follow-through; distinction between CHoCH, MSS and BOS
sources.limits: Commercial educational material; not audited profitability evidence or universal terminology

sources.title: ChoCh in Trading: What It Is, How to Spot It & Trade It
sources.author: ATAS
sources.supports: Context, retest zones, volume/footprint and delta examples
sources.limits: Illustrative charts and platform promotion do not demonstrate a net edge

sources.title: Wyckoff Method
sources.author: Wyckoff Analytics
sources.supports: Broader price/volume and range-phase interpretation of change of character
sources.limits: Not the same algorithm as a strict pivot break; not an empirical CHoCH profitability test

sources.title: Smart Money or Costly Folklore? A Systematic Evaluation of ICT/Smart-Money-Concepts Trading Rules in G10 FX
sources.category: SSRN working-paper posting; peer review not verified
sources.access: Indexed primary abstract only; direct HTML/PDF requests returned HTTP 403
sources.supports: Direct CHoCH/SMC research lead; abstract reports mixed/inverted directional findings in FX
sources.limits: Full methods, code, costs, search design and results not audited; no demonstrated MNQ/MCL applicability

sources.title: Foundations of Technical Analysis: Computational Algorithms, Statistical Inference, and Empirical Implementation
sources.access: Author's publication record and abstract; linked full-paper retrieval unsuccessful
sources.supports: Formal pattern recognition and incremental information in some daily stock patterns
sources.limits: Not CHoCH, not micro futures, not proof of executable net profits

sources.title: Support for Resistance: Technical Analysis and Intraday Exchange Rates
sources.publication: New York Fed Economic Policy Review 6(2)
sources.access: Institutional record and full text accessed; selected findings and conclusions inspected
sources.supports: Predictive content of some published intraday FX support/resistance levels
sources.limits: Varies by firm and currency; not a CHoCH futures strategy test

sources.title: Stop-Loss Orders and Price Cascades in Currency Markets
sources.publication: Journal of International Money and Finance 24(2), 219-241
sources.category: published research article with institutional working-paper record
sources.access: Institutional summary and published citation inspected
sources.supports: Stop clusters can propagate rapid continuation rather than automatic reversal
sources.limits: Historical FX evidence; no proof of candle-inferred institutional intent or CHoCH net alpha

sources.title: Evidence and Behaviour of Support and Resistance Levels in Financial Time Series
sources.category: arXiv preprint; journal publication not verified
sources.access: Primary abstract and full text accessed; selected methods/findings inspected
sources.supports: Bounce behavior can depend on level interactions and age
sources.limits: Detected barriers and conditional probabilities do not establish a costed CHoCH system

sources.title: The Price Impact of Order Book Events
sources.category: published research article with author-submitted preprint
sources.access: Primary abstract and publication reference inspected
sources.supports: Order-flow imbalance differs from aggregate volume and relates to short-horizon price impact
sources.limits: US-stock microstructure, not an out-of-sample futures entry-rule test

sources.title: Data-Snooping, Technical Trading Rule Performance, and the Bootstrap
sources.access: Published record/indexed abstract plus accessible LSE 1998 predecessor; selected conclusions inspected
sources.supports: Adjustment for the searched rule universe and later-period testing
sources.limits: Some earlier performance survived adjustment; not a blanket claim that technical signals never work

sources.title: Technical Trading Revisited: False Discoveries, Persistence Tests, and Transaction Costs
sources.access: Published record/indexed abstract and an accessible author-deposited July 2009 draft; full final article not accessed
sources.supports: Persistence, false-discovery and transaction-cost concerns in technical-rule selection
sources.limits: Draft and final data windows must not be conflated; not a universal verdict on other markets/frequencies

sources.title: What Do We Know About the Profitability of Technical Analysis?
sources.category: peer-reviewed review article, as classified by the institutional record
sources.access: Institutional publication record and abstract inspected; full final text not accessed
sources.supports: Mixed empirical literature and important methodological limitations
sources.limits: Historical study counts are not an estimated success probability for CHoCH
